notes_for_editor: Single source: the tnlandforms list row, which gives coordinates and county only. The table's elevation (230) has no unit label, so the story leaves it out (the record converts it as feet, 70.1 m; please verify). The author states that names for towers 73 and up are their own creation; this row is GA122, so 'dark bay' may not be a name used locally. Checked with no match: NHLR Georgia list (cached), Eastern US Lookouts Georgia index, Georgia Historic Newspapers search for 'dark bay' tower (no results), and two web searches. Site status, access and history are unknown.
